name: block-hero-figure
use: The first screen of a page with a figure beside the title: the title, one sentence, one or two actions and a small label on the left, a route card on the right that shows how the product works.
avoid: A first screen without a figure (take block-hero-centered); any place but the first screen of a page.
props: { kind: 'block-hero-figure'; pill?: string; title: string; description: string; cta?: { label: string; href: string }; secondary?: { label: string; href: string }; children?: Block[] }

cases.title: Home page of a payment element: how a payment goes, beside the title
cases.why: The reader sees the promise on the left and how it works on the right, without scrolling.

props.pill: OpenSource Web4 agent & app starter kit
props.title: Card payments for every element of your node
props.description: Your shop or booking page asks this element for a payment link with one call. The buyer pays on the own page of Stripe.

children.title: How a payment goes

stations.name: Your element
stations.text: Asks for a payment link: the amount, the currency and its own order number.

stations.name: Stripe element
stations.text: Creates a Stripe Checkout session with your keys and returns its link.

stations.name: Stripe Checkout
stations.text: Takes the card on the side of Stripe; card numbers never pass through your computer.

stations.name: Your Stripe account
stations.text: Receives the money at the prices of Stripe.

children.note: Stripe then sends a signed event back, and the element records it for the element that sold.

docs: npx shadcn add @fractera/block-hero-figure (and block-route-card for the figure). Needs ui/badge and ui/button of the element template. In a page: { "kind": "block-hero-figure", "title": "…", "description": "…", "children": [ { "kind": "block-route-card", … } ] } as the first block.
